newsitem.title: USA: Nissan pulls franchise from Virginia dealer.
newsitem.headline: Nissan pulls franchise from Virginia dealer.

text.p: Nissan Motor Corp. USA, a unit of Japanese automaker Nissan Motor Co. Ltd., cancelled its franchise agreement with a Virginia car dealership after the owner allegedly used a racial slur to describe a black worker.

Nissan Public Affairs Manager Kurt von Zumwalt said Friday that the automaker delivered a termination letter on Dec. 11 to Bob Crumpler, the owner of Nissan dealerships in Newport News and Portsmouth, Va. who has 90 days to respond.
"The damage done to reputation -- to ours and to his -- can't be undone," von Zumwalt said.
Crumpler was secretly videotaped making the offensive remark by a man who works at the dealership.
Crumpler was not reachable for comment.
